name: Forward Cut
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the authoritative Ashen Spire DECK & RELICS concept board, used only as composition, subject and style reference. Reconstruct only the painting inside the Forward Cut deck tile in the upper desktop feature, reference artwork rectangle x629..716, y204..291 of the 1448×1086 board. Deliver one edge-to-edge standalone high-resolution square ability painting, no card frame, plaque, lettering, number, medallion, text, UI or watermark. Subject/composition: a dark cloaked swordsman in silhouette, facing right, torso low-left, one arm and long sword reaching diagonally up-right. A thin glowing red-orange blade arc rises into the pale warm dusty sky; ruined broken towers behind. Broad readable black figure silhouette, wind-torn cloak, sparse flame accents; an upward cut rather than horizontal close-up slash. Style: faithful miniature-to-master reconstruction, weathered dark fantasy cinematic painterly realism, rough cloth, tarnished steel and smoky ruined stone, the same restrained sepia/charcoal atmosphere as this board. Retain the reference pose, dominant silhouette, movement direction and palette. Tight crop so the subject remains readable inside a small square deck-art window; no new unrelated characters, symbols or equipment. Fill entire square with painted art; do not return the whole reference board.

referenceRoles.role: authoritative deck illustration composition and style

review: Viewed full output against board07: cloaked dark figure lower-left with sword reaching diagonally up-right, red blade accent and dusty ruined skyline retained. More detailed ember rendering than the tiny reference; pose and card-window readability accepted. No baked UI.
